settings.text: Not for lack of ideas. Filming feels awkward, editing takes an evening and the views never come. The course fixes those three.

settings.title: The plan
settings.text: Week one. Pick three topics you can talk about every week, and write thirty video ideas in one sitting with our idea sheet.

settings.title: The shoot
settings.text: Week two. Light, sound and framing with a phone by a window. Film a week of videos in one afternoon.

settings.title: The edit
settings.text: Weeks three and four. Hooks, cuts, captions and music, in the same order every time. Under an hour per video.

settings.title: The habit
settings.text: Weeks five and six. A posting schedule you can keep, reading your numbers, and turning one good video into five.

settings.question: Do I need a camera?
settings.answer: No. Every lesson is filmed and edited on a phone. Week two has a short kit list, a clip on microphone and a small light, all under $100.

settings.question: How much time does it take?
settings.answer: About three hours a week: two short lessons, filming and editing your videos, and the Tuesday review if you can make it.

settings.question: Which platforms does it cover?
settings.answer: Vertical video for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. The same video works on all three, and one lesson shows what to change for each.

settings.question: I hate being on camera. Will this work?
settings.answer: Yes. One module is about formats where you never show your face: hands, voiceover, screen and product videos.

settings.question: Is it for brands or for personal accounts?
settings.answer: Both. The lessons work the same, and the examples include a coach, a bakery, a clothing shop and a software company.

settings.question: Can I get a refund?
settings.answer: Yes. Write within 30 days of joining, for any reason, and you get your money back.
